name: Nexus-Threat-Updated
title: Nexus Threat (2.1)
author: Karu_Kiruna, updated by Alex Green
description:
Nexus Addon: storms, instability and the shield on Nexus.
Nexus-Threat by Karu_Kiruna, updated for Factorio 2.1 until the original has a 2.1 release. Prototype and setting names are unchanged, so a save with Nexus-Threat can switch to this mod.
